description: This file contains shell functions used for firmware upgrade and system management specific to Linksys devices, including retrieving target firmware, identifying factory images, performing upgrades, and managing boot partitions.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition based on boot environment variables and ubi partition status.

methods.name: linksys_is_factory_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided firmware image matches the device's footer signature and board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process, including handling different magic numbers and image types, and cleaning up OEM firmware volumes.

methods.name: linksys_get_cmdline_rootfs_device
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device from kernel command line arguments.

methods.name: linksys_get_current_boot_part_emmc
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition on eMMC storage by reading environment variables and command line.

methods.name: linksys_set_target_partitions_emmc
methods.description: Sets the target kernel and root filesystem partitions on eMMC based on current boot partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys_emmc
methods.description: Handles the eMMC upgrade process, including setting target partitions and performing the upgrade.
